name: The Lid
description: The climax, chapter `the-lantern` (STORY.md §16): the `the-lantern` mission on Sela's far side (lon 180°, opposite `sela-relay`). The Lid: a crater 150 u across north-east of the drop, with terraced walls (four benches stepping down to a floor 34 u below the plain) and a raised platform at the centre holding the Lantern's core (`lantern-core`). We land outside it at `drop-zone` (the Core's pad). Three locks stand on the rim, each a node of relic grid `lid` with two sentinels (`lid-lock-n`, `lid-lock-e`, `lid-lock-w`): the Survivors' code opens the Lid, otherwise destroy the locks (when all three nodes fall, the `lid` cache at the core pays out). A ramp cuts through the south-west rim down to the second terrace (`breach`). Relic grids `terraces` (Accord-pattern sentinels on the benches) and `core-ring` (three sentinels, three nodes round the platform). When `lid-open` is set: `core-guard` (4 sentinels at the core) and the Lantern's raised units. No wildlife packs (airless). Rich seams on the floor. Factions: the Lantern (team 4, hostile) holds batteries round the rim and the core platform and raises Accord-pattern units when the Lid opens (`lid-raised`, `lid-raised-heavy`, `terrace-watch`); the breach battery (team 5, hostile) covers the cut and goes neutral when the Choir jams it (`lantern-choir`, on `choir-fragment`); Engram (team 6, neutral) is allied on `engram-defected` (`engram-wing` holds the breach) or hostile on `engram-purge` (`engram-purge-wing` attacks; set by `lantern-engram-purge` when Engram doubled down and survived). Kindred marines (`kindred-ally`) land as our units (`lantern-kindred`); the Vell's song reveals the map (`lantern-vell`). The strike force is the expedition package.

sites.label: Drop zone: we land under fire, outside the Lid
The Lantern's core: destroy, seize or give in
The breach: a cut through the south-west rim
